edit_base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one vertical 9:16 keyframe of a coherent four-shot creator craft process, for a scroll-controlled editing demo. Reference image is the continuity reference for the SAME charcoal tabletop, realistic artist hands, black sleeves, iridescent lilac paper, locked overhead 45-degree camera and cool upper-left studio light. Preserve framing, materials, color, hand identity and photographic realism. All action in the middle 65 percent of the portrait. No other props, text, logos or watermark. Change the paper and hands to the next stage only.
edit_stages: The artist has folded the sheet into a neat small diamond base, pinching a sharp diagonal crease with two hands; the process is visibly underway, not a finished bird.

The same iridescent lilac sheet is now an almost finished origami crane: both hands gently pull its two folded wings outward, the pointed head and long tail emerging. Crane clearly recognizable, tactile paper folds.

The finished iridescent lilac origami crane stands at the center of the same table with broad wings fully open, one hand delicately supports its body with fingertip while the other hand retreats. Clearly completed final result, elegant real paper, not glass or a living bird.
